description: Change a company LMS licence: seats, end date, languages, customer data; lock/unlock (locked stops every video at once, even running sessions); free seats of learners who left; rotate the token secret. Superadmins only; called by an agent, it is parked for approval.

locked.description: true = lock (no playback at all), false = unlock

offline_allowed.description: allow (true) or forbid (false) self-contained offline packages; without our server there is no seat, lock or expiry control

release_student_ids.description: free the seats of these LMS learner ids (matched by hash, never stored)

items.description: cmi.core.student_id as the LMS shows it

rotate_token_secret.description: true = new signing secret; open player links stop working, learners simply relaunch in the LMS

valid_until.description: new end: YYYY-MM-DD (end of day UTC) or ISO date-time

name: lms_license_update
